molecules.name: Glutathione (GSH)
molecules.label_th: กลูต้าไธโอน
molecules.role: Master hepatic antioxidant; conjugates NAPQI (from acetaminophen); 90% of body GSH in liver

molecules.name: N-Acetylcysteine (NAC)
molecules.label_th: เอ็น-อะเซทิลซิสเทอีน
molecules.role: Cysteine precursor → replenishes GSH; FDA-approved antidote for acetaminophen overdose; mucolytic

molecules.name: Silymarin (Silybin complex)
molecules.role: Antioxidant + anti-fibrotic; membrane-stabilizing; weakly inhibits CYP2C9 + P-glycoprotein

molecules.name: Tauroursodeoxycholic Acid (TUDCA)
molecules.role: ER-stress reducer; hepatoprotective; prescription drug in China/Italy for cholestasis

molecules.name: Ursodeoxycholic Acid (UDCA)
molecules.role: FDA-approved for primary biliary cholangitis; displaces toxic hydrophobic bile acids

molecules.name: Choline
molecules.role: Required for VLDL export of liver TG; deficiency → fatty liver (Zeisel 2003)

molecules.name: Phosphatidylcholine (PC)
molecules.label_th: ฟอสฟาติดิลโคลีน
molecules.role: Main component of cell membranes; essential for VLDL assembly; hepatic ratio PC/PE regulates steatosis

molecules.name: Berberine
molecules.label_th: เบอร์เบอรีน
molecules.role: AMPK activator; reduces hepatic DNL; hypoglycemic; inhibits DPP-4

molecules.name: α-Tocopherol (Vitamin E)
molecules.role: PIVENS trial — 800 IU/day improved NAS in non-diabetic NASH adults (Sanyal 2010 NEJM)

molecules.name: Curcumin
molecules.label_th: เคอร์คูมิน
molecules.role: Anti-inflammatory; NF-κB inhibitor; poor oral bioavailability without piperine/liposomal

molecules.name: Uric Acid
molecules.role: Final product of purine catabolism; elevated by fructose-induced ATP → AMP → IMP pathway; MSU crystals → gout

molecules.name: Fructose
molecules.role: Metabolized almost exclusively in liver via fructokinase (KHK); drives DNL + uric acid production; bypasses PFK regulation

molecules.name: ALT (Alanine Aminotransferase)
molecules.role: Leaks into blood when hepatocytes are damaged; liver-function test marker (normal <33-40 U/L)

molecules.name: AST (Aspartate Aminotransferase)
molecules.role: Less liver-specific than ALT; AST:ALT ratio >2 suggests alcoholic damage

molecules.name: GGT (γ-Glutamyltransferase)
molecules.role: Marker of biliary obstruction + alcohol exposure; inducible by CYP450

molecules.name: CYP3A4
molecules.role: Phase-1 enzyme responsible for ~50% of drug metabolism; inhibited by grapefruit furanocoumarins

molecules.name: CYP2E1
molecules.role: Metabolizes ethanol + generates NAPQI from acetaminophen; induced by fasting + alcohol

molecules.name: FXR (Farnesoid X Receptor / NR1H4)
molecules.role: Bile acid sensor; suppresses bile acid synthesis (CYP7A1); regulates lipid + glucose homeostasis

molecules.name: TGR5 (GPBAR1)
molecules.role: Stimulates GLP-1 release, energy expenditure, brown fat activity

molecules.name: NAPQI
molecules.role: Toxic intermediate of acetaminophen via CYP2E1; binds hepatocyte proteins → necrosis unless quenched by GSH

molecules.name: EGCG (Epigallocatechin-3-gallate)
molecules.role: Dose-dependent hepatotoxicity at >800 mg/day extract (USP/FDA warning 2018)

case_studies.name: Younossi NAFLD Global Prevalence Meta-Analysis
case_studies.claim_to_fame: ทบทวนงานวิจัย 86 รายการ รวม N=8,515,431 — NAFLD prevalence ทั่วโลก 25.24% (95%CI 22.10-28.65); ตะวันออกกลางสูงสุด 31.8%, Asia 27.4%

case_studies.name: PIVENS Trial — Vitamin E for NASH
case_studies.claim_to_fame: RCT N=247 non-diabetic NASH adults — Vitamin E 800 IU/day × 96 weeks ปรับปรุง histology 43% vs placebo 19% (p=0.001); pioglitazone 34%

case_studies.name: Belfort Pioglitazone NASH Trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: RCT — pioglitazone 45 mg/day × 6 months ปรับปรุง steatosis (-54%) + necroinflammation (-85%) + resolved NASH 55% vs placebo
case_studies.source: Belfort R, Cusi K et al., NEJM 2006;355:2297-307

case_studies.name: Choi Sugar-Sweetened Beverage Gout Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Health Professionals Follow-Up Study N=46,393 men × 22 ปี — SSB ≥2 servings/วัน → gout relative risk 1.85 (95%CI 1.08-3.16)

case_studies.name: Johnson Fructose → Uric Acid Pathway Review
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Mechanistic review — fructose เป็น 'ชนิดน้ำตาลเดียวที่ active gout pathway' ผ่าน ATP/AMP/IMP → uric acid; proposes uric acid เป็น 'cause' ของ metabolic syndrome ไม่ใช่ผลข้างเคียง

case_studies.name: Lustig 'Sugar: The Bitter Truth' Lecture
case_studies.claim_to_fame: UCSF 1h 30min lecture (YouTube 100M+ views) โต้แย้งว่าฟรุกโตสคือ 'พิษเรื้อรัง' — เป็นจุดเริ่ม mainstream anti-sugar movement

case_studies.name: Prescott NAC Acetaminophen Antidote Protocol
case_studies.claim_to_fame: IV N-acetylcysteine (Prescott protocol) ลด hepatic necrosis จาก paracetamol overdose — survival ~100% ถ้าให้ภายใน 8-10 ชม. (vs 5% mortality เดิม)

case_studies.name: USP Green Tea Extract Hepatotoxicity Review
case_studies.claim_to_fame: ทบทวน adverse events >150 cases — EGCG >800 mg/วัน สัมพันธ์กับ idiosyncratic hepatotoxicity; USP แนะ <338 mg/วัน + warning label
case_studies.source: Oketch-Rabah HA et al., Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402

case_studies.name: Loguercio Silybin-PC-Vitamin-E NAFLD Trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: RCT N=138 NAFLD — Realsil (silybin 94 mg + PC + vit E) × 12 mo ลด steatosis, ALT, HOMA-IR อย่างมีนัยสำคัญ
case_studies.source: Loguercio C et al., Free Radic Biol Med 2012;52:1658-65
